sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully implements the nonlinear-calculation conditional, preserves the required ship/calculation-case ownership boundary, requires the supplied evidence and explicit minor-deformation assessment without inventing a ratio threshold, and applies the required unit/datatype constraints.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Replace the three-way calculation-method sh:or with a true conditional: a calculation case that has nltl:nonlinearCalculationMethodValue must satisfy the nonlinear evidence, minor-deformation assessment, deformation/dimension, and ship-margin constraints; a case without that nonlinear controlled value must pass without requiring or inventing direct/prescribed method alternatives. Remove nltl:directCalculationMethodValue and nltl:prescribedAnalyticalProcedure branches, which are not I2-065 alternatives and can allow a multi-valued calculationMethod including nonlinear to bypass the nonlinear obligations. Use a non-nonlinear branch expressed as sh:not of the nonlinear-method property shape, so any case asserting the nonlinear value cannot escape through another method value.

Candidate faithfully implements the nonlinear-calculation conditional, preserves the required ship/calculation-case ownership boundary, requires the supplied evidence and explicit minor-deformation assessment without inventing a ratio threshold, and applies the required unit/datatype constraints.
